map.支持按\"日期\"或\"星期\"排会；同一日期/星期下，若两个会议时间段有交集即: Supports scheduling by "date" or "weekday"; on the same date / weekday, if two meetings' time ranges intersect, it is judged a conflict
map.时间格式为 HH:MM，结束时间须晚于开始时间: Time format is HH:MM; the end time must be later than the start time.

map.把一周内的会议安排（名称、日期、起止时间）录入，自动找出同一天时间区间重叠的会议: Enter a week's meetings (name, date, start/end time); the tool automatically finds same-day overlapping meetings, avoiding double-booking the same room or person.
map.跨部门协调周会时，先列出各方候选时段，用工具挑出互不冲突的组合，减少来回确认成本: When coordinating cross-department weekly meetings, list each side's candidate slots first, then use the tool to pick non-conflicting combinations, reducing back-and-forth confirmation cost.
map.排定培训或评审时，检测是否与已有的全员大会时间重叠，防止参会人分身乏术。: When scheduling training or review meetings, check whether they overlap with an existing all-hands, preventing attendees from being stretched thin.
map.录入：A 周一 09:00-10:30（周例会）、B 周一 10:00-11:0: Enter: A Mon 09:00-10:30 (weekly meeting), B Mon 10:00-11:00 (requirements review), C Tue 14:00-15:00 (client meeting). The tool finds A and B overlap at 10:00-10:30 (conflict); C conflicts with none, and suggests moving B to after 10:30 to separate them.
map.同一日期下，若两场会议的 [开始, 结束) 时间区间存在交集即判为冲突（端点相接: On the same date, if two meetings' [start, end) intervals intersect, it is a conflict (touching endpoints such as ending at 10:30 and starting at 10:30 are not a conflict). Meetings on different dates do not affect each other. The rule follows the actual scheduling policy; the tool only does interval math.
map.支持跨天或周期性会议吗？: Does it support multi-day or recurring meetings?
